source_title: Naiqui Macabroad Joins ‘Chicago P.D.’ Following LaRoyce Hawkins Exit
source_excerpt:

NBC ‘s Chicago P.D. hard-launched its newest cast member, Naiqui Macabroad, on Wednesday night on the fourth episode of Season 14. Macabroad plays Donovan “Penny” Watts, an officer who stands out from the rest for his bravery while tackling dangerous high-pressure calls. The young lawman also thrives working the field thanks to his friendly nature and his acquaintance with key people in the community.
2026 TV Cancellations Photo Gallery: Series Ending This Year & Beyond
In the episode, he works closely with Voight (Jason Beghe) and the Intelligence Unit following a murder in the 11th District-Harrison, Penny’s beat. At the end of Wednesday night’s episode titled “My Eye, My Call,” Voight recruits him to join his crew.
RELATED: 2026-27 Premiere Dates For New & Returning Series On Broadcast, Streaming & Cable Watch on Deadline
Macabroad’s arrival heralds a new era for the show, following LaRoyce Hawkins’ exit from the series in the latest season’s second episode. His character, Kevin Atwater, gets his happily ever after as he welcomes his first child, a son named Malcolm Atwater, with his love, Tasha (Karen Obilom). Following a particularly dangerous case that saw Atwater Sr. get shot while on duty, he chooses to leave the front lines and Chicago as a whole to explore a career as a teaching officer at the Academy in Georgia.
RELATED: How LaRoyce Hawkins Exits ‘Chicago P.D.’ In Season 14
A teaser for next week’s episode “Dark Imaginings” reveals Detective Kim Burgess (Marina Squerciati) will go undercover to bust a top drug dealer whose meth supply is lethal.
Macabroad’s prior credits include appearances on Crackle’s Startup , NBC’s Law & Order, Starz’s Power , and NBC’s Timeless .
